contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Ground rules' and 'Pull requests': tests with every change, pinned dependencies, synthetic data, ESLint. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
governance_justification: GOVERNANCE.md: roles, how decisions are made, releases through a protected environment. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: GOVERNANCE.md 'Roles' lists the maintainer, contributors and upstream with what each can do. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
bus_factor_justification: One maintainer today; GOVERNANCE.md explains how a second one joins.
documentation_architecture_justification: docs/architecture.md: components, data flow, build and release. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
documentation_security_justification: What the software protects and does not: docs/assurance-case.md (threat model, known limits) and SECURITY.md (scope). https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md
documentation_quick_start_justification: README 'Quick install (about 3 minutes)' gets a user from download to a first tool call. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/README.md
documentation_current_justification: Docs change in the same pull request as the behaviour (README tool table, CHANGELOG [Unreleased]); each release turns [Unreleased] into the release notes.
documentation_achievements_justification: The README front page links this badge. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/README.md
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites are GitHub and GitHub Pages; the project itself stores no passwords.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Installed add-ons update through the update manifest (updates.json on GitHub Pages); CHANGELOG says what breaks and what to do; the add-on warns about an outdated bridge.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: SECURITY.md 'Recognition': reporters are credited in the release notes and advisories unless they ask not to be. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY.md: private vulnerability reporting, 72 h acknowledgement, 7-day triage, patch release, coordinated disclosure, published GitHub advisories. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
coding_standards_justification: ESLint configuration (eslint.config.mjs) is the coding standard; CONTRIBUTING asks to keep privileged code in two files. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/eslint.config.mjs
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The Lint check (eslint .) is required to merge into main.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native code is compiled: the add-on and the bridge are plain JavaScript.
build_non_recursive_justification: The build is a single Node script per artifact (scripts/build-xpi-reproducible.cjs, scripts/build-mcpb-reproducible.cjs); no recursive build.
build_repeatable_justification: Builds are reproducible byte for byte from a tag (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, entries sorted by path with a fixed time); the release job rebuilds and refuses any difference. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/RELEASING.md
installation_common_justification: The XPI installs through Thunderbird's add-on manager (Install Add-on From File) and updates itself; the bridge ships as a Claude Desktop bundle (.mcpb) and a Claude Code plugin.
installation_standard_variables_justific: No installer writes to system locations: Thunderbird installs the add-on in the user profile.
installation_development_quick_justifica: CONTRIBUTING 'Working locally': npm ci --ignore-scripts, npm test, npm run lint, one build command. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
external_dependencies_justification: The add-on and the bridge have no third-party runtime dependencies (the bridge uses only Node built-ins); development dependencies are listed in package.json and pinned in package-lock.json; the vendored httpd.sys.mjs is listed in THIRD-PARTY.md.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot version and security updates (npm, GitHub Actions) and Dependabot alerts are enabled.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: npm dependencies come from the lockfile and are updated by Dependabot; the one vendored file (httpd.sys.mjs) names its upstream source in THIRD-PARTY.md.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: Every pull request and push runs unit tests (Node 22 and 24), Thunderbird compatibility checks and the end-to-end lab in a real Thunderbird (commonpost/thunderbird-mcp-lab).
regression_tests_added50_justification: 84 of the 99 fix commits since 2026-05-03 add or change a test (CONTRIBUTING rule 3 asks for a failing test with each fix).
test_statement_coverage80_justification: mcp-bridge.cjs: 94% of lines. extension/mcp_server/api.js is tested in Node by region and end to end in a real Thunderbird, where coverage is not measured; the measured total is 64%.
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING rule 3: new functionality comes with a test in the same pull request. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING rule 3 asks to say in the pull request which tests were added.
warnings_strict_justification: ESLint runs on every change with zero warnings; CodeQL and zizmor also run on every pull request.
implement_secure_design_justification: docs/assurance-case.md lists the secure design principles applied, with where each is implemented. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The only credential is the token between bridge and add-on, generated at random at each start; no credential is compiled in.
signed_releases_justification: Each release carries Sigstore build-provenance attestations (.sigstore.json) and the same statements as .intoto.jsonl; users verify them with gh attestation verify (RELEASING.md). https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/RELEASING.md
input_validation_justification: Every tool argument is checked against its schema and in its handler (types, sizes, paths, account restrictions) before use; see docs/assurance-case.md. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md
assurance_case_justification: docs/assurance-case.md: threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles and the common weaknesses countered, with known limits. https://github.com/commonpost/thunderbird-mcp/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md
